stories.headline: Kast launches Border Shield Plan with military deployment and trench construction on Peru-Bolivia border
stories.summary: President José Antonio Kast initiated the Border Shield Plan, deploying military equipment and personnel to build physical barriers including trenches, walls and surveillance systems along Chile's northern border with Peru and Bolivia to combat irregular migration and organized crime.

stories.headline: Kast announces National Reconstruction Plan with tax cuts and economic reforms in early presidency
stories.summary: President Kast presented a comprehensive National Reconstruction Plan featuring corporate tax reductions from 27% to 23%, elimination of VAT on housing purchases, and other economic stimulus measures. The plan also includes security and institutional reforms.

stories.headline: Kast administration withdraws 43 environmental protection decrees from Boric era
stories.summary: The new government withdrew 43 environmental protection measures from the previous Boric administration, including decrees protecting national parks, the Humboldt penguin, and other conservation measures. The move is part of Kast's pivot toward more business-friendly policies.

stories.headline: Carabineros sergeant Javier Figueroa dies after being shot in Puerto Varas during police operation
stories.summary: Sergeant Javier Figueroa Manquemilla died after being shot in the head during a police operation in Puerto Varas on March 11. He was hospitalized for eight days before his death was confirmed. President Kast attended his funeral and declared three days of national mourning.

stories.headline: Kast achieves strong initial approval ratings in early presidency polling
stories.summary: Multiple polls show President Kast beginning his term with approval ratings between 46-59%, higher than predecessor Gabriel Boric's initial numbers. The polls also show strong public support for his border security measures.

stories.headline: Codelco faces questions over dramatic production drop following December spike
stories.summary: Chile's state copper company Codelco reported its fourth-lowest monthly production in January after recording unusually high output in December 2025, leading industry analysts to question the validity of the year-end production figures.

stories.summary: Former President Gabriel Boric opened his new office in Bellavista and made his first public appearance since leaving office at a Frente Amplio ideological congress. He assembled a team including former government officials Antonia Illanes and Nicole Vergara.

stories.summary: Coordinated operations by Carabineros and PDI resulted in approximately 3,000 arrests between March 12-14, including fugitives and those with outstanding warrants. The operations were presented as part of enhanced security measures under the new government.

stories.headline: Chilean economy shows 2.5% growth in 2025 despite challenges
stories.summary: Chile's Central Bank reported 2.5% economic growth for 2025, exceeding preliminary projections of 2.3%. The growth was driven by domestic demand, investment, and consumption, though the Boric administration averaged only 2% growth over its term.

stories.headline: Foreign investment in Chile reached $14.15 billion in 2025, showing 13% growth
stories.summary: Chile's foreign direct investment totaled $14.15 billion in 2025, a 13% increase from the previous year and above the historical average. The growth was driven primarily by reinvestment of profits and new capital participations.
